sections.en: Square of the Sun and Saturn

summary.headline: Sun–Saturn Malefic Aspects
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Saturn’s opposition and square with the Sun, including war, tyranny, disease, famine, earthquakes, rebellions, market stagnation, and other calamities affecting rulers, soldiers, farmers, prisoners, and subjects. Muhyi al-Din Maghribi adds the significance of Mars in a watery sign, while cardinal signs and the first and fourth climes receive special attention.
